explanation: God's undeserved favor that grants people reconciliation with Him without them deserving it through their own works.
The deepest love and grace God shows to people, especially when they are in distress or have sinned.
The quality of being loyal and steadfast in one's conviction about God's promises regardless of external circumstances.
The Holy Spirit who gives power, guidance, and life to believers so that they can live in accordance with God's will.
A gift from God, often a spiritual ability or talent given for service to the church and other people.
A call from God based on His own plan rather than human merit, giving meaning and direction in life.
The concept of humiliation or shameful behavior that believers should avoid to preserve their witness to others.
The divine power that God gives to his servants through the Holy Spirit to do his will and stand firm in faith.
